weather.blurb: About as nice as Austin gets. Get outside.

air.blurb: Clear air. A great day to be outside.

lake.blurb: The lake is close to full — good for boats and for the summer water supply. Down a touch from last week.

pollen.note: Tree 2 · Grass 2 · Weed 3 · Ragweed, Elm, Grasses
pollen.blurb: Ragweed and elm and grasses are up. Allergy folks, take the pill before it takes you.

grid.blurb: Demand peaks near 64,900 megawatts; ERCOT has 91,600 ready and room to spare.

sun.blurb: The sun is up for 11 hours and 15 minutes today, and down by 6:52 p.m.
